rewrites.comment: Single-page app: any path that is not a real file must serve index.html, otherwise refreshing on an unknown URL returns a server 404 instead of the site's own 404 page.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so they can be cached forever.
Demo reels and posters are stable but not fingerprinted: cache for a day, then revalidate.
The CV is replaced from time to time, so it must not be cached hard.
